stage_status: offline Blender source, GLB, texture and previews generated; runtime NOT_RUN; art review pending

coordinate_contract.authoring: Blender metres, Z up; project mapping Godot (X,Y,Z) -> Blender (X,-Z,Y); glTF export Y-up
coordinate_contract.origin: BagRoot at body-bottom center; same BagRoot remains the single scene/controller placement owner
coordinate_contract.default_pose: upright snagged bag; body bottom at local Y=0 in Godot

node_contract.whole_object_motion_owner: W01 scene/controller moves BagRoot once; no GLB clip moves BagRoot

runtime_handoff.node_owner: W01 scene/controller is the sole owner of BagRoot world transform; do not duplicate or animate BagRoot from an AnimationPlayer

snagged.contact_alignment: BagRoot.to_global(Strap_SnagContact.position) must equal the authored visible-root snag point

action_sequence: Instantiate one BagRoot and align its Strap_SnagContact marker to the F14 visible-root snag point; the controller owns this transform.
After the authorized physical release action, play strap_release to completion while BagRoot remains fixed.
Move and rotate that same BagRoot to the scene-authored boardwalk-side contact point; do not spawn a second bag.
At the placement ground point, set BagRoot Godot rotation X=-90 degrees, unit scale, and origin Y=ground_y+0.060 m; keep scene-authored X/Z placement and optional yaw in the W01 controller.
Play strap_placed_rest on BagStrap after the BagRoot placement transform is applied.

placed.ground_support: BagBody lies on its broad back face; 0.060 m is half the 0.12 m body depth
placed.clip_targets: BagStrap shape-key weights only; BagRoot is not animated

texture.provenance: project-original deterministic tileable woven-canvas albedo generated by bag_v1.py; no external image source

contract.BagRoot: unchanged; remains the sole whole-object movement owner

contract.precondition: bag is in snagged rest pose and the physical action has been authorized by W01 interaction logic
contract.result: one continuous strap crown moves toward the player and falls clear of the root contact

contract.root_transform_owner: W01 scene/controller; this clip changes strap shape only
